```sh
kafka init
```

Scaffold a kafka.config file in the current directory

Shared options and defaults: [connection profiles, JSON output, logging and help](../../global-options/).

## Defaults

Chooses .ts when the project has tsconfig.json or a TypeScript dependency, otherwise .mjs. Existing files require --force.

## Flags

| Flag      | Description                                                    |
| --------- | -------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `--ts`    | scaffold kafka.config.ts (default when TypeScript is detected) |
| `--js`    | scaffold kafka.config.mjs instead                              |
| `--force` | overwrite the file if it already exists                        |

## Examples

```sh
kafka init
kafka init --js
kafka init --force
```

## Output

Illustrative, abbreviated output. Empty arrays show the result envelope; actual entries, identifiers, optional fields and broker errors depend on the request and cluster.

With `--json`:

```json
{
  "path": "/home/example/app/kafka.config.mjs",
  "format": "mjs"
}
```

Declared exit codes: `0`, `2`. See the exit-code reference for meanings.
